subject: pri-vt-td
title: PRI.VT.TD.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-19 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the diversion sequence in America can be talked of as patterns that occur within a given time cycle which invariably determine how a given group of people see themselves — both conceptually and vibrationally.' (C)PRI-VT-TD (principle vibrational tendencies) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what principle-vibrational-tendencies produces when crossed with affinity-dynamics, given that the diversion sequence is described as 'extremely sophisticated manipulation' rather than 'natural progressionalism.' PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branches from the main line and opens into WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) → TRS (transition) → POL-DY (political dynamics). POST (postulation) branches from the main line and opens into AFL (affinity alignment) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and into INFO-DY (information dynamics); INFO-DY opens into MT-INFO (multi-information) and (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) → AFI (affinity insight).
